concept.name: Feature engineering
concept.definition: Creating model inputs from raw data through domain-informed transformations, aggregations, interactions, lags, or encodings.
concept.intuition: It controls what information the model receives and in what numerical representation.
concept.mechanics: Specify each feature's information timestamp and window, implement it in a train/live-consistent pipeline, and test it without fitting on future rows.
concept.failure_modes: Fitting the operation on the full dataset leaks future information; revisions, outliers, and missing values can also distort results.
concept.misconceptions: A cleaner or rescaled dataset is not automatically more truthful; transformations must preserve timing and economic meaning.
concept.example: Daily closes are converted into lagged 5-day return, 20-day volatility, and price-to-moving-average features.
